shadowSentences: I love to read books every night.
My favorite season is autumn in the park.
Cooking new recipes helps me relax after work.
Traveling to different countries broadens my perspective.
Listening to music is essential for my daily routine.
Running in the morning boosts my energy for the day.
Volunteering in my community gives me a sense of purpose.
Gardening is a great way to connect with nature outdoors.
Spending time with my family is the highlight of my week.
Learning a new language opens doors to many opportunities.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your study habits when preparing for exams?
Q2: What challenges do you face while trying to stay focused while studying?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes an effective study environment?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone struggling with their study habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies related to sports.
questions: Q1: What sports do you enjoy playing in your free time?
Q2: Have you ever faced any obstacles when trying to stay active?
Q3: How important do you think sports are for maintaining good health?
Q4: What suggestions would you offer to someone looking to start a new sport?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about appreciation of art.
questions: Q1: What type of art do you enjoy the most and why?
Q2: Have you ever had difficulty understanding a particular piece of art?
Q3: What role do you believe art plays in society today?
Q4: How would you recommend someone who feels disconnected from art to engage with it?
